# Operation-level authorization matrix

**CURRENT_VERIFIED — static source, baseline cdeb1ca; dynamic every-operation authorization NOT_RUN.** Framework declaration, effective cookie eligibility and exact guard method chain are shown per operation. Shared dispatch guards require actual action arguments; no role is assigned from route names. Full method signatures/default required roles and expressions are in [method evidence](../10_Traceability/api-method-evidence.json), selected via each operation's guardMethodRefs in [source map](../10_Traceability/api-source-map.json). DTO/error/state/resource checks remain in the same cited source; guard lists are navigation, not unconditional permission sets.
